title: Accept an offline attachment only after protected local bytes and queue evidence re-verify

requirements.invariant: Until remote verification exists, locally accepted attachment bytes remain authoritative in protected local storage; their raw bytes never enter structured synchronized rows or command payloads.

Capture returns the existing path-free local-durability receipt only after protected bytes and exact environment, Principal, Account, parent, Attachment, byte-count, digest and timestamp queue evidence are durable and independently re-verified.
Accepted attachment work survives adapter and database recreation inside one validated environment/Principal/Account namespace, and no other namespace can enumerate, claim or decrypt that work.

Interruption, corruption, missing bytes, wrong keys, permission failure, storage exhaustion and metadata failure produce explicit fail-closed state; a failed new capture never evicts or silently discards previously accepted work.

The provider implements the existing backend-neutral capture port and exposes only pending count/order plus exact verified bytes for a future uploader; it has no remote-success, detach, delete, discard, cleanup, retention or eviction operation while O-023 remains open.

This bounded provider uses disposable local fixtures and synthetic bytes only; it does not touch Firebase, hosted Supabase or PowerSync, production credentials/data, app/MCP composition, migration or cutover and cannot advance A-003, A-004 or SPIKE-MED-001.

The provider derives a scope-partitioned location from the validated local-data namespace, uses a distinct injected media key, authenticates ciphertext metadata, applies platform protection and backup exclusion where supported, and refuses path traversal, link substitution or sensitive diagnostic leakage.

Every accepted but remotely unverified attachment remains visible in the provider's exact pending count, including explicit missing/corrupt evidence; this slice provides no logout, discard or cleanup action.

items: Reuse LocalAttachmentCapture, AttachmentLocalDurabilityReceipt and AttachmentCaptureStoring unchanged; provider failures remain bounded and cannot manufacture success evidence.
The provider owns opaque local-object and queue-state values only; no Supabase, PowerSync, filesystem path or cryptographic type crosses into LedgerTargetCore.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This local-only slice adds no Postgres relation, constraint, index, view or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No remote upload, metadata attach, verification, retry, completion, rejection or cleanup handler is implemented.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No Supabase Data API or Storage endpoint is exposed.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Local scope isolation is not server authorization; no RLS or Storage policy is claimed.

items: The isolated attachment table is declared localOnly, produces no ps_crud transaction and is absent from the structured upload connector and every Sync Stream.
All local reads remain bound to the store's exact validated environment/Principal/Account scope; this is local isolation evidence, not server authorization or shared-runtime composition.

One isolated PowerSync schema owns a local-only attachment queue keyed by stable Attachment identity with exact scope, opaque object identity, capture/persistence time, byte count, SHA-256, receipt fingerprint and explicit pending/corrupt state.

Enqueue serializes within one actor, verifies exact replay or rejects rebinding, durably promotes encrypted bytes before committing queue metadata, reopens/decrypts/re-hashes after commit, and returns no receipt on any earlier failure.
On recreation, accepted rows and pending order/count survive; missing or corrupt bytes become explicit unresolved state and never disappear or become uploadable.

A trusted scoped root uses an internally generated filename derived only after rejecting dot/reserved components and link substitution, platform complete data-protection attributes and backup exclusion, plus authenticated encryption under an injected per-namespace 256-bit key distinct from SQLCipher.
Authenticated associated data binds the contract version, namespace, scope, parent, Attachment, byte count and content digest; reads revalidate AEAD, count and digest before returning bytes.
A recoverable staging/final-object protocol classifies interruption orphans; exact replay deduplicates by Attachment ID, while equal bytes under different IDs remain separate.
Injected storage pressure and filesystem faults refuse only the new capture and preserve all previously accepted ciphertext and queue evidence.

appMcp.notApplicable: No app screen, picker, gallery, MCP tool or runtime composition is wired in this provider-only slice.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase reference, pending file, URL, Storage object or production-derived byte is read or transformed.

items: The adapter exposes deterministic pending count/order and explicit missing/corrupt evidence for tests; diagnostics contain stable codes but no bytes, paths, tokens or user content.
Physical-device protection, process-kill/power-loss, low-storage, seven-day soak and hosted private-Storage evidence remain named SPIKE-MED-001 follow-up obligations.
Implementation is confined to three newly claimed target-package leaves plus synchronized conversion controls and disposable fixtures.
No shared runtime/schema, application project, Firebase checkout, hosted resource, deployment, migration, production data or feature authority changes.
Rollback is deletion of the disposable local fixture; A-003/A-004 and O-023 remain unadvanced.

verification.expected: Synthetic capture yields the exact existing receipt only after ciphertext and queue evidence re-verify; raw files/metadata contain no plaintext bytes or provider/path locator.
Closing and recreating the vault/database with the same scoped root and keys recovers the identical receipt, pending count/order and verified bytes.

At every injected interruption before/after staging write, synchronization, promotion, queue commit and receipt return, recovery yields either one exact accepted record or an explicitly inventoried non-success staging/final orphan; no final file/row mismatch is invisible and only a committed exact replay may return the receipt.
Missing/truncated/tampered ciphertext, wrong key, changed count/digest and malformed metadata fail closed, remain counted as unresolved evidence and are never silently deleted or returned for upload.

Sequential and concurrent exact Attachment replay returns one identical receipt/row/object; concurrent changed-payload replay rejects deterministically, changed bytes/scope/parent/identity cannot rebind, and equal bytes with different Attachment IDs remain distinct.
Simulated insufficient space, permission, write, synchronization, promotion and SQLite failures return no receipt and never evict older accepted work.
Different environment, Principal or Account fixtures cannot enumerate, open, enqueue into or read one another's attachment namespace.
Pending order/count survive recreation, structured rows contain no raw bytes/provider locator, and reading a verified future-upload candidate never marks it uploaded or removes evidence.
Enqueue writes only the isolated localOnly attachment table, leaves ps_crud empty, appears in no structured upload path or Sync Stream, and cross-scope local reads return no candidate.

Dot/reserved local-object identities, tampered path metadata, symlink/hardlink substitution and root escape fail closed; queue rows and diagnostics contain no key, absolute path, plaintext or provider locator, and protection/backup attributes are asserted where exposed by the platform.

verification.expected: The exact synchronized commits pass focused and complete target tests, conversion/environment/contract controls and both staging builds without hosted access or source-app changes.

notes: READY scope is limited to deterministic local-provider proof. It deliberately exposes no remote success, retention/deletion behavior, shared runtime integration or app UI. O-023 remains fully open; A-003/A-004 and SPIKE-MED-001 remain unadvanced.
